heading: Wisconsin Urges FCC to Strengthen Anti-Robocall Rules
summary: Wisconsin DOJ and a bipartisan coalition asked the Federal Communications Commission to tighten its rules for voice service providers. Those rules require providers to check the sources of the calls they pass along. The coalition says stronger checks would help keep illegal robocalls off U.S. networks.

heading: Wisconsin Joins Challenges to Endangered Species Rules
summary: Wisconsin DOJ joined two lawsuits over changes to Endangered Species Act regulations. The cases name federal wildlife and fisheries agencies. The coalition argues the new rules weaken protections for imperiled species.

heading: Wisconsin Earns Financial Reporting Award for 30th Straight Year
source: Wisconsin Department of Administration press release
summary: The Department of Administration said Wisconsin again received a certificate for excellence in financial reporting. The Government Finance Officers Association issues the award. The department said it was Wisconsin's 30th consecutive year of recognition.
